html:
It’s no secret that 2018 was a huge year for us! We grew the Meridian Local family, got a big office makeover, helped a record-number of small business clients and so much more! Take a peek at the video below to see for yourself!

Here’s our biggest takeaway from 2018: None of our accomplishments would’ve been possible without our dedicated employees.

Every one of them is an essential part of the Meridian Local team—no matter if they’re making sales, building relationships with our clients or providing subject matter expertise. Without everyone firing on all cylinders and coming to work with can-do attitudes, we wouldn’t be where we are today.

We hit a lot of milestones this year, and we plan to hit even more in the years to come! We’re going to strive to maintain our company’s accelerated growth and continue adding to the Meridian Local family.

Cheers to 2018 and making 2019 even better!
